newsitem.title: UK: Greenpeace chase BP rig as it tries to escape.
newsitem.headline: Greenpeace chase BP rig as it tries to escape.

text.p: Greenpeace early on Wednesday chased the Stena Dee oil rig and just prevented it from reaching the Foinaven oil field on the fifth day of a cat-and-mouse game in the North Atlantic.
"We cannot give you the exact location yet, but the Stena Dee is now significantly closer to Foinaven," a Greenpeace spokeswoman said.
The British Petroleum Co Plc oil platform started moving at full speed at 0400 GMT to escape two Greenpeace vessels, which have effectively stopped the rig from moving ahead since Saturday.
"They had a head start on us, so we were a little way behind them, but we did catch up on them," the spokeswoman for the environment action group said.
"We then put four swimmers into the water ahead of them, bringing them to a halt," she added.
The Stena Dee was 15 miles (23 km) south of Foinaven and about 55 miles (88 km) northwest of the Orkney islands before it attempted to escape.
Greenpeace wants to stop the development of the Foinaven field, located north of Scotland, as part of a worldwide campaign against climate change.
